name: The Spirit Of Rejection
overview: The Spirit of Rejection is powerfully contrasted in Scripture by God's faithful acceptance and compassion toward His people. Though human relationships may fail, as in the forsaking by parents, the LORD promises to gather and uphold those who trust in Him (Psalms 27:10). Even when rejection is experienced, believers are reminded that God neither casts off His people nor forgets them, displaying unfailing love and care beyond human understanding (Psalms 94:14; Isaiah 49:15). This theme is profoundly embodied in Christ, who was Himself despised and rejected by men, yet through His suffering, believers find acceptance and restoration (Isaiah 53:3; Luke 10:16).
